description: This file defines the UploadSession model and related functions for handling file uploads in the Mattermost project, including validation, auditing, and constants for upload types.

classes.name: UploadSession
classes.description: Struct for tracking file upload sessions, including metadata such as ID, type, user, filename, size, and status.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of session details for auditing purposes.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the session by generating ID and timestamp if missing.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the session's fields, returning an error if invalid.
